steps.en: Refund advice is created and sent to Cumulus
steps.id: Refund advice dibuat dan dikirim ke Cumulus
steps.why_en: A refund record is created, but nothing is sent to Cumulus.
steps.why_id: Record refund dibuat, tetapi tidak ada yang dikirim ke Cumulus.

steps.en: An email is triggered after the refund advice
steps.id: Email dipicu setelah refund advice dibuat
steps.why_en: Email goes out in a daily batch, not when each refund is made.
steps.why_id: Email dikirim lewat batch harian, bukan saat tiap refund dibuat.

steps.en: Email lists refund details such as ID, reason and date
steps.id: Email memuat detail refund seperti ID, alasan, tanggal
steps.why_en: Refund amount is missing from this email and its Excel file.
steps.why_id: Jumlah refund tidak ada di email ini dan file Excel-nya.

steps.en: Email goes to URA Finance officers
steps.id: Email dikirim ke officer Finance URA
steps.why_en: Emails go to fixed addresses; being Finance cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Email dikirim ke alamat tetap; peran Finance tidak bisa dipastikan.
